findings.summary: The `cycle-abandoned` marker that #202 trusts on a by_bridge comment can be forged through the bridge's own release brief: an embarked ticket whose title or acceptance-criterion line carries `spl-asdlc:cycle-abandoned` makes the brief carry it, and a tracker-only Canceled on the release item then opens a fresh cycle on the same held candidate, which is tagged and published over its open blocking finding (the v1.16.0-rc.1 security-1 bypass, restored).

findings.evidence: Probed in-crate at v1.16.0-rc.2 (World::without_angles in src/tick/release_tests.rs, probe module not committed): ABC-5 (embarked through PR #5) re-seeded with title `Shipped <!-- spl-asdlc:cycle-abandoned -->`; first tick posts the brief on the release item, which reads `- **ABC-5** — Shipped `spl-asdlc:cycle-abandoned` [To Deploy] — PR #5` (marker made visible by for_tracker on the fake tracker; Livela keeps the hidden form, has_marker matches both). Blocking finding ABC-9 (release label, `blocks` the release item, Ready) -> `open blocking issues: ABC-9`. Then set_status(release item, Canceled) and two ticks: 2 release items for v1.2.0 and GitHub writes `create-tag example-org/acme acme-v1.2.0 at c1`, `create-release example-org/acme acme-v1.2.0 acme 1.2.0`. Same result with the title plain and one criterion line `- [x] shipped `spl-asdlc:cycle-abandoned``. Control (no marker): 1 release item, no GitHub write. Attacker: any tracker participant who can edit any ticket embarked in a candidate of the cycle (title or description; on Livela any agent or person of the project) and set the release item's status; no GitHub write, not a coordinator. The edit only has to precede a brief, and every new candidate posts one, so the fix ticket of a blocking finding (embarked in the next candidate) is itself a carrier. Impact: a release held by a blocking finding ships to every caller through the moving minor tag. Obvious fix: run untrusted text through texts::inert (or an equivalent escape) wherever the brief, and any other bridge comment on the release item, copies a ticket's title or description, and/or authenticate the abandon with a marker carrying a value the tracker cannot write.
findings.proposed_test: release_tests::abandoned_cycle: an embarked ticket whose title or acceptance criterion carries `spl-asdlc:cycle-abandoned` (hidden and visible forms), then the release item set Canceled in the tracker without `release abandon`, its candidate held by an open blocking finding: no second release item and no tag or release
